title: Broadcast to xDrip (step2)
symptom: The user is sending glucose values to xDrip every 3 minutes and asks if xDrip can show every value, and also asks for explanations of parameters in the OOPResultsContainer code, suggestions for closer cooperation, and whether to send unit (mmol/L or mg/dL).
fix: xDrip can only show a new message every 5 minutes or more. The user should send values at intervals of at least 5 minutes. Also, xDrip uses mg/dL.
evidence_quote: xDrip can only show a new message every 5 minutes (or more). The reason is that there are many places in the code (for example, raise, or drop alerts) that will need to be changed.
